counterfactual_policy_support.note: Two independent per-player recurrent folds score retained operator actions. These are support and probability checks, not new games or sampled policy behavior.

failure_preserved.cause: Rewardable map Scholar SPELL Component carries native value zero; initial notice normalizer required absent value. Narrow adapter correction accepts zero only for map Scholar and normalizes the delivered spell component without changing native rewards.

independent_audits.scope: Snapshot of the pre-tamper draft only; final artifact requires separate review.

paired_coverage.claim: At least one unchanged policy sample in each enumerated family for each color; not all alternative answers

scope_limits: All authored fixture preparations, scripted mechanic answers and paired seed diagnostics are excluded from training and ordinary outcome-frequency claims.
Two bounded unassisted fixed-weight games reached no natural outcome and establish no strategic improvement. Native terminal controls demonstrate reachable normal endings only.

The sixteen family/color pairs (eight families for both colors) have sampled neural answers; two original context captures without the requested dialog remain unverified. All alternative answers are not claimed as neural samples.
Random missing branches remain unverified in their original cohorts. The three later provenance-bound paired seed diagnostics close specific mechanism gaps, not unbiased outcome frequencies.

Only enumerated native dialog and notice grammar is supported. Custom authored guard text, full-army neutral GarrisonDialog, arbitrary modded dialogs and broader spell/artifact/skill UI are not covered.
Chest XP evidence binds displayed choice, accepted native reply, unchanged gold and capped hero level; numeric XP is not a new observation field.
Artifact and Scholar evidence checks the actual delivered components; this does not add full inventory or spellbook observation or action support.
Pre-send invalid-choice rejection is not a server-rejected acknowledgement; a successful reply acknowledgement alone is not a claim of its later effect.
Normal fog and player-local callback histories are bound. Hidden native positions, fate, query IDs, answer IDs, native RNG variables and latent reward alternatives are not learner inputs.

At collection limits an active strategic dialog is answered only by real bounded unchanged policy choices; continuation after the frozen learning prefix does not invent strategic answers. Unsupported cleanup fails unscored.
This v7 tamper suite supplements earlier v5/v6 evidence; it does not rerun or claim every inherited capability edge case.
Raw artifacts and game assets remain local; this compact file commits identities and summaries only.
Natural terminal controls cover the current request-origin all-AI profile with two ExplorerRL players. Initial-state and timer-origin terminal classes remain unsupported and are not claimed.

Inherited live edge gaps remain: multiple upgrade alternatives, unavailable or unaffordable upgrades, seven-slot capacity conflicts, wandering-hero cap rejection, and actual native server-rejected acknowledgements were not newly exercised in this v7 cohort.

A wholly transient enemy sighting that disappears between decisions remains unverified in a v7 live game. Callback ordering and player-local histories are checked, without claiming that specific native visibility edge.

semantic_tamper.scope: Rehashed witnessed dialog/notice/receipt mutations under native offline replay; altered tapes are retained locally. Unsupported unwitnessed variants are not claimed.
